acceptance: Shortening a package doc that sits below a //go:build line passes `evolve comments verify` as comment-only (red first, on a fixture pair taken from acs/cycle14)
A real change to the build directive is still reported

consumed.resolution: Root cause: the package doc in acs/cycle14 mentions IPC-protocol-allowed in prose, and the marker rule matched it in any comment of any file, so the edit changed a directive. No anchor field moved. verify now reads the marker only in files that envtaint parses (internal/envscope); a build directive change is still refused.

fix: Reproduce the false report with a before/after fixture pair from acs/cycle14, find which field of anchoredDirectives differs (nextToken, blank or paragraph), and make that field independent of the text and length of an unrelated doc comment. Keep the check that a moved or edited directive is still reported.
summary: In go/acs/cycle14/predicates_test.go the file starts with `//go:build acs`, then a blank line, then a package doc. Editing that doc makes `evolve comments verify` report "directive changed" (Equivalent -> anchoredDirectives in go/internal/commentaudit/equivalence.go). The lane had to leave acs/cycle14 untouched. The cause is not yet pinned: scanDirectives anchors on nextToken (code tokens only), trailing, blankBefore and paragraph, and none should move with the doc text. Reproduce with a before/after pair first.
title: comments verify reports a directive change when the package doc below a build directive is edited
